$comment: Copy into <project>/.claude/settings.json. The package guard ships with the Windows/PowerShell command because that is the platform where the POSIX form fails OPEN: if `sh` is absent the hook exits 127, which is a hook ERROR, not a block, so the guard silently stops guarding. On macOS/Linux swap the hook command for: sh .claude/hooks/guard-packages.sh. Whichever you use, run .claude/hooks/verify-guard.ps1 (or verify-guard.sh) after install — it proves the guard actually blocks instead of assuming it does. Extend the allowlist with project-specific read-only commands as prompts appear.
